asset.label: BCeID — Wordmark, reversed (rebuilt)
asset.sourceLocator: Rebuilt over the website’s 2× reverse logo (220 × 58)
asset.dateNote: Rebuilt in 2026 from an undated web image; no adoption date.
asset.notes: “BCeID” in Garamond capitals with an italic e in gold, white for a dark ground, redrawn as outlines over the website image. No vector original was found: the website, its guides and forms carry the wordmark only as images.
asset.fidelityNote: Vector reconstruction. Letters set in EB Garamond (SIL Open Font License) and converted to outlines: capitals at weight 400, the e in EB Garamond Italic at weight 600. The original cut of Garamond is not verified. Each letter is scaled to its height in the source image and placed in its measured box; overlap with the source is 0.79 for the capitals and 0.65 for the e (IoU). Colours sampled from the image: white and #E3A82B. No live text, no embedded image.

asset.label: Compass — Needle symbol (rebuilt)
asset.dateNote: Rebuilt in 2026 from an undated web image; no adoption date.
asset.notes: The blue needle — a circle drawn to a point at the upper right — with a white C. No vector original was found on translink.ca, compasscard.ca or in TransLink PDFs checked.
asset.fidelityNote: Vector reconstruction from geometry fitted to the 561 px PNG: the needle is one large circle joined by its tangents to a small rounded tip; the C is a ring cut by two horizontal lines (measured from the image). Overlap with the source: 0.998 for the needle, 0.987 for the C (IoU). Colours sampled: #0099CC, white. No tracing, no embedded image.
